config.sampler: AES-256-CTR deterministic pseudorandom words, rejection to unbiased integer range

sources.provenanceLimits: Early CPU executables used reusable paths subsequently overwritten; their recorded hashes are not a claim those CPU binaries remain available. Only the separately frozen polynomial CPU binaries are rechecked here. Earlier 16/18-group log runner versions are not preserved by the surviving 22-group runner, so these two corrected datasets remain archival/source-limited. Most early pilots and all per-observation timestamps were not preserved. No reconstructed source history or fresh timing qualification.

tests.algebraicProof: 1664525 == 1 mod 4; 1013904223 == 3 mod 4; reduction modulo 2^32 preserves modulo 4. For n divisible by four, seed % n retains those forced residue classes.
tests.limits: Tests establish implementation controls and a concrete failure of the historical resampler. Cryptographic pseudorandom sampling is deterministic, not a proof of statistical independence of recorded timing blocks; both new intervals remain conditional on sampling assumptions.
